title: Disk I/O Saturation — Node Storage Pressure
symptom: Node disk utilization >90%; pods entering Evicted state; kubelet logs showing 'eviction threshold has been met'; write latencies >500ms on persistent volumes.
remediation_steps: Identify saturated node: kubectl describe node <node-name> | grep -A10 Conditions
Check disk usage on node: df -h && du -sh /var/lib/docker/*
Prune Docker/containerd unused layers: crictl rmi --prune
If persistent, drain and reschedule: kubectl drain <node-name> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
Expand PVC if applicable: kubectl patch pvc <pvc-name> -p '{"spec":{"resources":{"requests":{"storage":"50Gi"}}}}'
